Feature: Mail to support@ creates a Customer Support ticket (test route check)
Preconditions: DEV setup once per test run. Odoo sign-off: an Incoming Mail Server pointed at a QA intake mailbox that routes like the alias support@ (team Customer Support); crons are inactive, so mail is fetched with Settings > Technical > Email > Incoming Mail Servers > Fetch Now. FF staging: inbound is off by default (pull job stopped, IT access for supportodoo@ pending, E06-T1); the DEV enables the staging test Email Account on a QA intake mailbox and runs its pull. If a route is missing, record Blocked for that system and every case that cites this one.
Steps:
1. From the QA sender mailbox send a new mail (not a reply) with subject 'QA-MAIL-001 cannot connect to repository' and a 3-line body to the Odoo intake mailbox, and the same mail to the FF intake mailbox.
2. Odoo: Fetch Now on the test Incoming Mail Server. FF: ask the DEV to run the pull (or wait up to 10 minutes if the job is on).
3. Odoo: Helpdesk > Tickets, search 'QA-MAIL-001'. FF: agent UI https://support-crm-mig.nakivo.site/helpdesk/tickets, All Tickets, search 'QA-MAIL-001'.
4. Count the tickets found and open the ticket.
A expected (Odoo 12): Exactly one new ticket in team Customer Support; the mail is the first message in the chatter.
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): Exactly one new ticket with Team 'NAKIVO Customer Support' (never empty); the mail is the first item of the conversation.
Test data: Sender: QA test mailbox 'qa.alice' on the QA test mail domain, registered in both systems as contact 'Alice Tester' of company 'ACME Test Ltd' (a probe contact, never a real customer). Subject 'QA-MAIL-001 cannot connect to repository'.

Feature: New ticket fields taken from the mail (title, requester, team, status)

Steps:

B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): Ticket subject = the mail subject; requester (raised by) = the bare sender address (display name not kept); team 'NAKIVO Customer Support'; status Open; no assignee (manual claim, as Odoo).

Test data: Sender: QA test mailbox 'qa.alice' on the QA test mail domain, registered in both systems as contact 'Alice Tester' of company 'ACME Test Ltd' (a probe contact, never a real customer).

Feature: Outgoing mail on staging: demo guard and where to read the mail
Preconditions: A probe ticket in each system whose requester is '<customer>@example.com' (not on the FF demo allowlist). FF staging: mute_emails = 1 and a demo allowlist are on (ask the DEV for the allowlisted addresses). Odoo sign-off: crons inactive.
Steps:
1. Open the probe ticket and send a reply 'QA-MAIL-003 please send the logs' (Odoo: chatter Send message, pick a Stage; FF: Reply under the conversation, pick a Stage, Send).
2. Odoo: enable developer mode (?debug=1), open Settings > Technical > Email > Emails, filter on the subject.
3. FF: look at the ticket conversation, then Desk https://support-crm-mig.nakivo.site/app/email-queue filtered on Reference Name = the ticket number.
4. FF: open Desk /app/hd-ticket/<number> and scroll to the comments; open /app/error-log and search 'DEMO GUARD'.
A expected (Odoo 12): The reply is in the chatter with its recipients; a mail.mail row in state Outgoing exists for <customer>@example.com and is never delivered (crons inactive). There is no demo guard in Odoo.
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): The reply is stored in the conversation with its text, but '<customer>@example.com' is removed from its recipients; no Email Queue row is created for that address; the ticket gets the comment 'DEMO GUARD: blocked 1 outbound recipient(s) not on the demo allowlist: <customer>@example.com' and an Error Log 'DEMO GUARD blocked outbound mail (ticket <number>)'. Nothing reaches the customer.
Comparison note: The demo guard is a staging-only safety rail (E06-T3); Odoo sign-off simply never sends because its crons are off.

The DEV provides Wufoo form .eml samples (From no-reply@wufoo.com, body lines 'Name:\t...' and 'Email:\t...') with the address replaced as the case says. The DEV places the provided sample .eml unchanged into each intake mailbox (IMAP append), then runs the fetch (Odoo: Incoming Mail Server > Fetch Now; FF: the pull of the test Email Account). Form type 'Submit a new feature request'; Email = qa.alice.
Steps: 1. Inject; fetch / pull; open the ticket; read outgoing mail.
A expected (Odoo 12): Requester re-pointed to qa.alice; no acknowledgement for feature-request forms.
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): Requester / Contact = qa.alice; no acknowledgement.

Feature: Reply editor defaults (bottom Reply)
Preconditions: A probe ticket in both systems whose requester is qa.alice (FF: an allowlisted address, so the Email Queue row is created) with ticket Carbon Copy = qa.bob.
Steps:
1. Open the probe ticket (Odoo: chatter Send message; FF: Reply under the conversation, no message picked).
2. Read the editor before typing: greeting, signature, quote, To, CC, Bcc field, Stage selector.

B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): Editor: 'Hello <contact full name>,' plus your signature, both editable; no quote; To = qa.alice; CC = qa.bob + support@nakivo.com; no Bcc field.

Feature: Reply on a single message: quote and recipients
Preconditions: A probe ticket in both systems whose requester is qa.alice (FF: an allowlisted address, so the Email Queue row is created) with ticket Carbon Copy = qa.bob. The ticket has a customer mail from qa.alice with Cc qa.bob, '<customer>@example.com' and an internal @nakivo.com address, and an earlier agent reply that carried a rating block.
Steps:

2. Read greeting, quote, To and CC; then press Reply on the earlier agent reply and read its quote.
A expected (Odoo 12): To = qa.alice; CC = qa.bob, <customer>@example.com, support@ and the ticket Carbon Copy (internal and support addresses skipped from To); 'Hello Alice,' then a quoted From / Date / To / Cc / Subject header with the message; the old rating block is removed from the quote.
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): To = qa.alice; CC = the other external addresses (qa.bob, <customer>@example.com) + support@nakivo.com + ticket CC (internal, support, lm-callhome and L1 addresses skipped); 'Hello Alice,' then the quoted header and that message only (no double quote); the old rating block is stripped.

Feature: What the editor shows is what is sent (body and recipients)
Preconditions: A probe ticket in both systems whose requester is qa.alice (FF: an allowlisted address, so the Email Queue row is created) with ticket Carbon Copy = qa.bob.
Steps:
1. Open Reply; change the greeting to 'Hi Alice,'; delete the last signature line; type 'QA reply text'.

3. FF: open the Email Queue row (Message, Recipients, Cc) and the stored mail in the conversation. Odoo: open the mail.mail row.
A expected (Odoo 12): The mail holds exactly the edited body; CC = qa.bob + qa.carol (support@ removed by the agent).
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): The queued message equals the stored reply: edited greeting, shortened signature, text, no second greeting added by the server; CC = qa.bob + qa.carol, support@ absent because the agent removed it; In-Reply-To set; no Bcc.

Feature: Forward a message
Preconditions: A probe ticket in both systems whose requester is qa.alice (FF: an allowlisted address, so the Email Queue row is created) with ticket Carbon Copy = qa.bob. The ticket has a customer mail with a PDF attachment.

Feature: Shared reply templates in the editor
Preconditions: A probe ticket in both systems whose requester is qa.alice (FF: an allowlisted address, so the Email Queue row is created) with ticket Carbon Copy = qa.bob. L1 agent inside the review window (Mon 02:00 - Sat 02:00 Kyiv).

Feature: L1 reply held for review sends no mail until approved
Preconditions: A probe ticket in both systems whose requester is qa.alice (FF: an allowlisted address, so the Email Queue row is created) with ticket Carbon Copy = qa.bob. Two L1 logins (author and reviewer); test inside Mon 02:00 - Sat 02:00 Kyiv time.

2. Read outgoing mail (none expected) and the ticket status.

4. Read outgoing mail and status again.
A expected (Odoo 12): Held: no mail, the message becomes a note, ticket -> Pending (L1); after Approve one mail From support@ with the rating block, note 'Message by X reviewed by Y. Result: approved.', stage On Customer.
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): Held: no Email Queue row, badge 'Pending review', ticket -> Pending (L1); after Approve exactly one mail From support@nakivo.com with the rating section, note 'Message by X reviewed by Y. Result: approved.', status On Customer.

Feature: Rejected held reply is never sent

Both systems must point at the Jira that holds the test issue (A: system parameter jira_path; B: Jira settings in NAKIVO Helpdesk Settings); if not, record Blocked. A: crons are off on sign-off: run 'Fetch JIRA comments' (Settings > Technical > Scheduled Actions > Run Manually). B: the 5-minute Jira job must be running on staging (else ask the Administrator to run it once). Five probe tickets keyed to the same test issue ITSM-<n>: statuses Escalated, On Customer, Hibernate, Closed, and one marked as a related ticket of a master (E16).
Steps:
1. Add a new comment 'QA dev comment 2' on ITSM-<n>.
2. Run / wait for the Jira job.
3. Read the status and timeline of each of the five tickets; look for mails to customers.
A expected (Odoo 12): Escalated, On Customer and Hibernate move to Open; the related ticket only gets the note; the Closed ticket is not touched.
B expected (Frappe Helpdesk): Escalated, On Customer and Hibernate move to Open with 'Reopened automatically: a new developer comment arrived.' and a stage stamp; the related ticket keeps its status but gets the comment; the Closed ticket is unchanged; no mail goes to customers.
